record: PRESCORE - ghi truoc khi doc noi dung file test

locked_design.algorithm: OLS co he so chan, chi log_open_prev = ln(open_prev)
locked_design.e1_e4: da thu tren dev, khong dat quy tac thay E0; KHONG cham tren test
locked_design.fit_for_test: fit tren toan bo 725 dong dev; he so E0 va median uoc luong lai truoc khi du bao test

evaluation_object: 193 transition test (fold 0), cung tap cho ba phuong an

metric_definitions.primary: MAE log gop = mean |Y - Y_hat| tren 193 transition
secondary: MAE TB theo franchise (TB cua MAE moi franchise)
sai so diem phan tram: |100(exp(Y)-1) - 100(exp(Y_hat)-1)|, bao mean va median
theo tang open_prev <1M va >=1M kem n dong, n franchise
metric_definitions.paired: delta_MAE = MAE_baseline - MAE_E0; duong = E0 sai so thap hon
metric_definitions.bootstrap: bo tro: boot theo franchise, ghep cap, giu du bao co dinh

rule_note: Quy tac 3/4 fold chi dung giai thich lua chon tren dev; test la mot tap giu lai duy nhat
selection_reason: Ca bon cau hinh E1-E4 deu co MAE gop cao hon E0 (E1 +0.0071 du thap hon E0 o 3/4 fold; E2 +0.0001; E3 +0.0032; E4 +0.0058) nen khong cau hinh nao dat cong; giu E0. Chon E0 KHONG co nghia E0 hon baseline don gian.
